g.text: Performance response to increasing spatial exclusion

g.text: Random is shown as a permissive reference; block-only, +2-hop and +5-hop splits form the buffered spatial family. Shared y-axis is used across panels.

g.text: Increasing spatial exclusion: block-only -> +2-hop buffer -> +5-hop buffer
